Author: lavaskin
Name: Mentor Roulette Tracker
Description: Keeps track of your Mentor Roulette runs, with their wipes, the party's deaths and your time, and logs them to your account on Mentor Roulette Tracker (mentorroulette.com).
Punchline: Logs your Mentor Roulette runs to Mentor Roulette Tracker.
Changelog:
### Added

- Each run records the party's deaths, alliance raids included, and the site shows them.
- The runs window has a Deaths column.

### Fixed

- Wipes in dungeons and guildhests are counted now.
